description: Currency must equal 'GBP' for all rows (documented business rule).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.DimSavingsAccount WHERE Currency IS NULL OR Currency <> 'GBP'

description: ValidFrom should not be in the future relative to the system time (inferred ETL rule).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.DimSavingsAccount WHERE ValidFrom > SYSUTCDATETIME()

description: Rows marked IsCurrent = 1 should not have a ValidFrom in the future (current version starting in the future is suspicious).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.DimSavingsAccount WHERE IsCurrent = 1 AND ValidFrom > SYSUTCDATETIME()

description: AccountMaturityDate is populated for rows where ProductCode is not 'FIXED_1Y' (typically maturity should only exist for fixed-term products).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.DimSavingsAccount WHERE AccountMaturityDate IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(ProductCode,'') <> 'FIXED_1Y'

description: AccountNumber must not be an empty string or whitespace (beyond being non-NULL).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.DimSavingsAccount WHERE AccountNumber IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(AccountNumber)) = ''

description: CustomerID must not be an empty string or whitespace (beyond being non-NULL).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.DimSavingsAccount WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CustomerID)) = ''
